name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more correspondents by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; submission does not confirm recipient delivery.

name: fork_session
description: Fork an activity from your retained history and the supplied task, returning its stable session_id. The inherited history includes the complete calling model/tool round. Your activation continues, and the core receives a completion report when the activity session ends.

task.description: Activity to pursue from the inherited understanding.

name: send_session_message
description: Durably queue an observation for an existing session. A dormant recipient becomes ready; an active recipient receives it between complete model/tool rounds.

session_id.description: Recipient session ID; the current roster lists existing sessions.

name: wakeup
description: Schedule one observation for this session and return its callback_id. The arrangement survives restart and keeps an activity available while it waits. Past times are due immediately; inference can occur later.

at_unix_ms.description: Unix time in milliseconds. Current runtime time is supplied in state.

text.description: What to reconsider when this observation arrives.
